note: Cumberland County GIS lists municipal zoning but publishes no queryable county zoning service (only a data request form and static PDF maps). No Vineland, Millville or Bridgeton zoning service found. The only queryable district layer is NJ Pinelands Commission's Pinelands_Municipal_Zoning (services1.arcgis.com/nCm6SZaiGMuGX35l), covering only certified Pinelands municipalities in the county; it has no districts at the county's interior point, so it fails validation.
